traffic_enabled.description: Whether traffic statistics are on, which writes the nginx access log. Default: off

retention_days.description: How many days the hourly statistics are kept, 7 to 365. Default: 30

show_ips.description: Whether client IP addresses are stored and shown. Default: off; turning it off deletes the stored addresses

unique_visitors.description: Whether unique visitors are counted with keyed IP hashes. Default: off; turning it off deletes the stored hashes

visitors_cap.description: How many distinct visitors are counted per host and day, 1000 to 1000000. Beyond it new visitors are not counted and the day is marked as capped. Default: 100000

locked.description: Fields set by environment variables (read only)

locked_by.description: The environment variable that sets each locked field (name only, never the value)
